name: Li Wei
bio:
Li Wei's journey into motorsport began during his university days, fueled by a passion for engineering and a fascination with Formula One. After graduating with a degree in Mechanical Engineering from Tsinghua University, he initially worked at a domestic automotive manufacturer. However, his desire to combine his technical skills with the thrill of racing led him to pursue opportunities in motorsport. He started as a data analyst for a small racing team before quickly rising through the ranks, demonstrating exceptional organizational skills and a keen eye for detail. 

As Head of Operations at MP Motorsport Junior, Li is responsible for ensuring the smooth and efficient running of all trackside and workshop activities. He believes in fostering a collaborative environment where every team member feels valued and empowered. His flexible approach allows him to adapt quickly to changing circumstances and make critical decisions under pressure. What sets him apart is his ability to blend meticulous planning with on-the-spot problem-solving, ensuring the team is always prepared for any challenge.
